confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Algarve resort pricing for July peak season; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than hotel and hostel anchors, which vary widely by season, room type, and booking lead time. Cocktail and wine were set from the local beer relationship (cocktail about 2.75x beer, wine about 1.25x beer) because direct knowledge is weak. The FX rate comes from search snippets of rba.gov.au pages; the RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other Algarve coastal resort towns such as Lagos and Portimao, adjusted for Albufeira's heavy July tourist demand and bar-strip pricing.
